name: ADHD Printable Planner Kit
source_note: Bundle built by the Product Builder from the pages of products #1 v2, #2 v2 and #3 v2.

listing.title: ADHD Printable Planner Kit - Today Page, Energy Planner and Focus Sheets (A4 + US Letter)
listing.description:
Three printable planners in one PDF, for adults who want simple paper pages that work with their energy and attention.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, the Today page (time anchors, Top 3, now / next / later, waiting for / errands, wins, guess vs real time, sixteen 15-minute focus blocks, tomorrow's first step and a brain dump), the Energy-Based Daily Plan page, the Low-Energy Reset Sheet, the Weekly Capacity & Rhythm page, the Unload & Sort page, the Weekly Overview page, the Monthly Review page, the Notes & Reflections page, the Brain Dump & Sort page, the Daily Focus Sheet, the Project Micro-Step Breakdown page and the Weekly Reset & Clear Out page.

Print it on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults with ADHD or time blindness who like simple printable planners

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Start each day with the Today page. On hard days, use the Low-Energy Reset Sheet instead.
When your head feels full, use the Brain Dump & Sort page, then move three things to the Daily Focus Sheet.
Plan the week with the Weekly Overview and look back with the Monthly Review.
cover_image_idea: The Today page and the Energy-Based Daily Plan page on soft pastel paper.
